summary: crates/editor-snippets rev 4: no src/ change, two new integration test files plus a dev-only path dependency on flashtex-edit-ledger. Objective 1 (actual existing consumer fixture): apps/mac (Swift) has no Rust/FFI dependency on this crate or any crate today (Package.swift only pulls in pure-Swift targets; repo-wide grep for editor-snippets/SnippetPlan outside this crate is empty), so tests/real_consumer_edit_ledger.rs instead drives a SnippetPlan through the real, same-language, in-repo consumer of computed edits -- flashtex-edit-ledger's actual Store::apply/apply_group -- proving a linked \begin{X}/\end{X} placeholder's offsets survive a real byte-range splice and that retyping one linked occurrence propagates to both via a real GroupedEdit/SourceEdit transaction; a stale plan is independently refused by the real store exactly when this crate's own staleness() already flagged it. The cross-language claim is pinned separately: PreparedEdit (wire-compatible with transfer-v1 per its own doc comment) serializes to exactly the field set docs/contracts/transfer-v1.md specifies and TransferV1.CaptureEdit (apps/mac/Sources/FlashTeXProtocol/TransferV1.swift) decodes -- the contract the bridge actually carries, not a pretense of invoking Swift. Objective 2 (measured limitations): tests/corpus_snippet_coverage.rs derives 22 realistic snippet shapes from the commands/environments actually in tests/tex-corpus/cases/**/main.tex and pins exact Snippet::parse outcomes. Measured: 1/22 parses today; the dominant, previously unmeasured blocker is that this crate's backslash is reserved for its own escape grammar (\$ \} \\ only) and rejects any literal LaTeX command or LaTeX's own escaped specials (\% \& \_ \#) as InvalidEscape -- 13 of the 14 shapes needing zero fuller-LSP features fail on this alone, dominating the three previously-documented gaps combined. Isolated probes (free of that confound) independently confirm and rank those three: choice placeholders needed by 4/22 (hard UnterminatedPlaceholder), named/special variables by 3/22 (braced form hard InvalidPlaceholderIndex; bare form silently mis-parses -- parses unchanged, no error at all), transforms by 1/22 (hard UnterminatedPlaceholder, least frequent). Rev 1-3 guarantees (linked edits, tab order, UTF-8 safety, plan identity/staleness, adversarial bounds, no mutating method) untouched. cargo test 87/87 (85 integration + 2 doc-tests) passing; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean.
next_action: Await Commander integration; a follow-up revision could fix the InvalidEscape-on-literal-backslash defect this measurement surfaced (pass through any \<non-escape-char> as literal instead of erroring) before choice/named/transform grammar work would even matter for real LaTeX snippets
